_comment: One shadow study (see shadow/README.md). The top-level fields are the Oracle's hypothesis spec
(agentcenter :8767/api/hypotheses), so a hypothesis becomes a study by adding `query` and `shadow`.
`query` must validate as causal_core.contract.CausalQuery and `decision` (plus `outcome`) as
Fill `decision` and `query.segment_by` before anyone sees a result: choosing them afterwards is
the researcher degree of freedom the platform exists to remove.
title: Retention discount for customers flagged at risk
statement: Offering the retention discount lowers 90-day churn by at least the minimum worthwhile effect, and harms no declared segment
graph: tenure -> discount; tenure -> churned; plan -> discount; plan -> churned; discount -> churned

decision.action: offer the retention discount to customers flagged at risk

caveats: Who was offered the discount was decided by account managers; the graph names what they looked at.

data.decision_window: the rows available when the decision was or will be made (a data_path, or a named export)
data.follow_up_window: the later rows the follow-up will be measured on

shadow.human_decision: what the people responsible decided, recorded when known, without the platform's verdict in view
